participation.context: Wrote the two lines with the same pen.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the two lines and closed the book. You did not enter a price for the stores.

title: Wrote that Verona ended, and a pound of candles at fourpence

participation.context: Heard, at the rushlights. She was not in the question.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Heard, below. He did not come up.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

story.body: You told her it was done, and that all of them were punished. Nobody else was asked.

title: Said it was done and all of them were punished

participation.context: Guessed once, carried, and paid nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the prices in her book and told him so at each stall.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Carried with him, and kept the beef from being counted twice.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: he may carry and he may not price
relations.quote: I will not write four shillings because you liked the sound.

story.body: You went stall to stall, guessed four shillings, and were refused. You paid nothing. You took the near corner of the side and the bottom of the firkin.

relations.note: he may carry and he may not price
relations.quote: I will not write four shillings because you liked the sound.

participation.context: Carried a sack, and is not in the picture.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You carried one sack in from the close and left the basket where the heaver had set it down.

title: Took a turn with a sack

story.body: You stood in the aisle and went home with nothing added to the day.
